title: Horseshoe lemma with prescribed end resolutions
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with enough injectives [def-sp-enough-injectives], and let $0\to A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C\to0$ be a short exact sequence in $\mathcal A$. Let $s_A:A\to I_A^\bullet$ and $s_C:C\to I_C^\bullet$ be given injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions] with $I_A^n=I_C^n=0$ for $n<0$. Then there exist an injective resolution $s_B:B\to I_B^\bullet$ with $I_B^n=0$ for $n<0$ and morphisms of complexes $\alpha:I_A^\bullet\to I_B^\bullet$, $\beta:I_B^\bullet\to I_C^\bullet$ such that $\alpha^0\circ s_A=s_B\circ f$, $\beta^0\circ s_B=s_C\circ g$, and for every $n\geq0$ the sequence $0\to I_A^n\xrightarrow{\alpha^n}I_B^n\xrightarrow{\beta^n}I_C^n\to0$ is short exact. (One may take $I_B^n=I_A^n\oplus I_C^n$ with $\alpha^n,\beta^n$ the inclusion and the projection.)

proof.text: Extend the degree-zero augmentation of IA along the monomorphism S.f by Injective.factorThru. Form w=(lift,S.g≫IC.ι.f 0). The augmentation squares hold by biproduct extensionality. Apply ShortComplex.mono_τ₂_of_exact_of_mono to this diagram, whose outer vertical maps are the mono augmentations of the two injective resolutions. Thus w is a monomorphism.

Apply the fixed-initial-embedding construction to obtain K, ι, α, β, short exact rows, degree-zero exactness, and e_0 carrying ι^0 to w. The isomorphism e_0 and monomorphy of w imply monomorphy of ι^0.

Each row splits by injectivity of IA^n, using ShortExact.splittingOfInjective. Its isoBinaryBiproduct identifies K^n with IA^n⊕IC^n. Biproducts of injective objects are injective, and injectivity is invariant under isomorphism, so K is degreewise injective. The splitting identities and biproduct extensionality give α^n e_n=inl and β^n=e_n snd.

Degreewise short exactness gives a short exact sequence of complexes. For n≥1 its homology sequence and vanishing of both outer homologies give H^n(K)=0; in Lean this is ShortExact.exactAt_X₂. Degree-zero exactness together with the mono augmentation gives that ι is a quasi-isomorphism in degree zero, by quasiIsoAt₀_iff and quasiIso_iff_of_zeros. Bundle K and ι as an InjectiveResolution. Retain the augmentation equalities and row witnesses, and supply the degreewise splitting isomorphisms.

lean.statement: theorem exists_horseshoe_prescribed_resolutions {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [EnoughInjectives C] (S : ShortComplex C) (hS : S.ShortExact) (IA : InjectiveResolution S.X₁) (IC : InjectiveResolution S.X₃) : ∃ (IB : InjectiveResolution S.X₂) (α : IA.cocomplex ⟶ IB.cocomplex) (β : IB.cocomplex ⟶ IC.cocomplex), IA.ι ≫ α = (CochainComplex.single₀ C).map S.f ≫ IB.ι ∧ IB.ι ≫ β = (CochainComplex.single₀ C).map S.g ≫ IC.ι ∧ ∃ (hαβ : α ≫ β = 0), ∀ n : ℕ, ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map (HomologicalComplex.eval C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)).ShortExact ∧ ∃ e : IB.cocomplex.X n ≅ IA.cocomplex.X n ⊞ IC.cocomplex.X n, α.f n ≫ e.hom = biprod.inl ∧ β.f n = e.hom ≫ biprod.snd
